questions.question:
Observe the dots on a dice (one to six dots) in the following figures. How many dots are contained on the face opposite to that containing four dots?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c9fdf85feff129b56d1c5e93cb1f8ad47f7eb0a2d06d5e00a4f80c153a49f5c.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'four dots', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0881b4ab7abc82e757589d4864d2c1cfff389c1b2e4f51b42f0bed1580c97316.png] 

From both dices, 5 and 3 dots are common. So, remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

So, **Six dots **will be opposite to four dots.

Hence, the correct answer is "Six".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ E _ T _ W _ R T C W _ R _ C W E _ _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: C _ E _ T _ W _ R T C W _ R _ C W E _ _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) WRCEETRT → C __**W**__ E __**R**__ T / __**C**__ W __**E**__ R T / C W **__E__ **R __**T**__ / C W E __**R**__ __**T**__

Here, 'C W E R T' is the pattern.

Option 2) WRCERTRT → C __W__ E __R__ T / __C__ W __E__ R T / C W __R__ R __T__ / C W E __R__ __T __

Option 3) WRCERERT → C __W__ E __R__ T / __C__ W __E__ R T / C W __R__ R __E__ / C W E __R__ __T__

Option 4) WRCETERT → C __W__ E __R__ T / __C__ W __E__ R T / C W __T__ R __E__ / C W E __R__ __T__

Hence, the correct answer is **"****WRCEETRT".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

14 × 2 ÷ 9 - 5 + 18 = 76
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given equation: 14 × 2 ÷ 9 - 5 + 18 = 76

Option 1) ÷ and ×

Two signs need to be interchanged then:

⇒ __**14 ÷ 2**__ × 9 - 5 + 18 = 76

⇒ __**7 × 9**__ - 5 + 18 = 76

⇒ __**6**____**3**__ - 5 __**+ 18**__ = 76

⇒ __**81 - 5**__ = 76

⇒ 76 = 76

Option 2) ÷ and +

questions.question: Six friends Farheen, Pooja, Richa, Sonika, Vani and Tanya are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Farheen is an immediate neighbour of both Pooja and Richa. Sonika is sitting second to the right of Pooja. Vani is sitting third to the left of Richa. Tanya is an immediate neighbour of both Sonika and Richa. Who sits to the immediate left of Tanya?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six friends Farheen, Pooja, Richa, Sonika, Vani and Tanya are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Vani is sitting third to the left of Richa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e28a0713d7f86e3f548d86793ca6fc28fbff4aaebc7d76719aef2906ae7090bc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533cdb2b628f9c19fac6e3540d52a4fd9fc59bbc8facf0b014a56c1eb6919c65.png] 

2) Sonika is sitting second to the right of Pooja.

3) Tanya is an immediate neighbour of both Sonika and Richa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/488bea030624d10f3c389612eea7fdf3b10980cf52035ca3a99f6a32c0f8e3b8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b30e8139088ceeeeb412e7512248d9b655ccbc20a6eecdff9ef1555a97f5d8a8.png] 

4) Farheen is an immediate neighbour of both Pooja and Richa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2845b703c6c7d5bddf1cf3002059954e7265ba9802350c67a857d96826b1370d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3096c7b027c9f86fc6befd7066bb823d4e52a4cad1a56ee3fabe3200a02ea0a0.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Sonika sits to the immediate left of Tanya.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
